title: Draft: dfilter: Add reference counting to tree nodes
description:
Instead of doing a full duplication of node objects use references
with counting.

This is an optimization. If it introduces difficult to deal with
issues it may have to be reconsidered.

commits_data.title: dfilter: We need to handle FVALUEs in the parse tree
commits_data.message:
dfilter: We need to handle FVALUEs in the parse tree

During semantic checking we transform semantic types to
concrete types. With reference counting the later can
appear in the parse tree from a previous pass if a
node is duplicated, i.e. its reference count is > 1.

An example would be the filter "ip.proto < 6 < 17".

The parse tree is LT(ip.proto,6) AND LT(6,17).

During the semantic check for the LHS of the AND test 6
has the semantic type UNPARSED. During the semantic check
of the RHS of the AND 6 is the same object as the LHS and
has the concrete type FVALUE[UINT8], not UNPARSED.

We need to handle that. Treat an FVALUE semantic check as
an STRING if the type is a string type or as UNPARSED
otherwise.
